# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are only made for the latest release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report security problems through public issues, discussions or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/halitsever/explain-to-customer/security/advisories/new). If that isn't available, email [halitsever@protonmail.com](mailto:halitsever@protonmail.com).

A useful report includes:

- the affected version or commit
- steps or a proof of concept to reproduce the issue
- the impact you expect

You should get a first reply within a week. Once the issue is confirmed, a fix is released as soon as possible and you're credited in the advisory, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
